description: Three exact, single-case private-header mutation probes for public ExPolygon conversion contracts. Apply one replacement to a private overlay per run; never edit the canonical header.

mutants.description: For each hole output slot in to_polylines(const ExPolygons&), copy that region contour and close the copied ring using its own first point. Output count, ring length, and closure stay valid; the ordinary exact point-sequence CHECK fails at the hole slot.
mutants.test_filter: ExPolygon collection polyline conversions preserve ring order

mutants.description: Retain one pointer per hole but direct each hole slot to the owning ExPolygon contour. The vector size and lifetime remain valid; pointer identity checks distinguish the wrong ring address.
mutants.test_filter: ExPolygon polygon pointer views refer to the original rings

mutants.description: Move only each contour into polygons_append(Polygons&, ExPolygons&&), omitting holes. The destination is still a valid Polygons value; the ordinary output-count REQUIRE exposes the missing rings. The test does not inspect moved-from source contents.
mutants.test_filter: Appending ExPolygon rings preserves destination prefix and source order
